Hi Marcus / Marissa —

Thanks again for getting the SOW over the line. Attaching an initial mutual action plan (RT_MAP_v1.pdf) that embeds the post-signature implementation milestones: canary cohort, migration window, training plan and evaluation criteria. High-level asks from our side:

- Two-week canary starting week of Nov 8 in us-west-2 (cohort ~10 pilot users)
- Production migration target: Nov 29–30 cutover (low-traffic window)
- Two 90-minute training sessions for power users + PM office hours the week prior
- Evaluation plan based on KPIs below and a shared prompt test set

Proposed KPIs for the evaluation plan (we can refine):
- Response latency P95 < 350ms for 95% of requests
- Token cost delta <= +15% vs baseline model with equal quality
- Functional regression rate < 1% on the canonical prompt set

Can Marcus propose internal leads for engineering, rollout owner and training coordinator? Also flag any constraints in dedicated capacity we should know about (network egress, allowed regions). I’ve copied Priya for contract items and AWS Marketplace touchpoints.

Attachments: RT_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with timeline and owners).

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
RenewalTrack

Thanks — adding the technical checklist and a suggested migration playbook. Highlighting the items that will materially affect the Nov 29–30 target:

- Infra prep (complete by Nov 10): dedicated GPU pool provisioning in us-west-2, VPC peering rules, and KMS key sharing. Owner: Karthik
- Data & prewarm (complete by Nov 17): RenewalTrack provides S3 prewarm payload and prompt test set. We will verify prefix/KV cache prewarming during canary. Owner: RenewalTrack + Redwood Eng
- Canary deployment (Nov 8–21):
  - Day 0–2: smoke + functional tests; rollback threshold: >= 3 critical errors in 1 hour or P95 latency > 600ms for > 15 minutes
  - Day 3–7: scale to full pilot; automated scaling enabled
  - Day 8–14: expand cohort if metrics are stable
- Cutover runbook (Nov 29–30): scheduled 02:00–06:00 PT to move traffic with DNS TTL changes and traffic shifting over 30 minutes with 5% increments. Rollback via immediate traffic shift back to control if regression > 1% on functional test set

I’m attaching an example deployment manifest and a short checklist (canary-deployment.yaml). Note: we’ll need a HubSpot webhook from RenewalTrack to surface health events back to their tracker. Also request a sandbox DocuSign envelope id if you want us to reference it in the runbook.

Risks / mitigations:
- Risk: unexpected egress costs during prewarm -> Mitigation: cap prewarm bandwidth and run a cost-estimate simulation in Staging
- Risk: model output regressions -> Mitigation: pairwise A/B evaluation and rapid rollback policy in the runtime

I’ll be on the technical scoping call — propose Thursday 10/22 09:00 PT.

-Karthik
